description: Delete 2 to 100 messages from a guild channel in one request. The whole request fails if any message is older than 14 days or any message ID is duplicated. To delete a single message instead use discord_delete_message. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Manage Messages. Destructive: the user is asked to approve the exact change before it runs.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel containing the messages to delete

message_ids.description: Array of 2 to 100 unique message IDs younger than 14 days to delete

reason.description: Audit log reason sent in the X-Audit-Log-Reason header (up to 512 characters)

name: discord_bulk_delete_messages

channel_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

items.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
